Name: Antisocial
Author: dreakj
Description:
[size=6]Welcome to Real Socialization
[/size][size=3]Have you ever wanted socializing to be more difficult for your farmer? Do you want the farmer to have a social battery just like you do? Do you want your UI to look like you worked hard after you ran around giving gifts to people all day? Do you just want the game to be more hardcore?[/size]

[size=5]Introducing Antisocial!
[/size][size=3]In this mod, your farmer will lose energy when they speak to villagers. This includes any speaking interaction, gift interaction, and can include cutscenes (see parameters below). You can even let your farmer pass out as if they were using a tool![/size]

[size=5]Parameters[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]EnergyCost (int): amount of energy spent for each interaction. default 2[/size]
[*][size=3]DisableForEvents (bool): whether to lose energy in events. Note that any new dialogue box from another character will decrease energy. default false[/size]
[*][size=3]CanPassOut (bool): whether the player can pass out from socialization interactions. If false, energy will not decrease if it would go below -15. default false[/size]
[/list]

This is my first mod, so please comment with any bugs/incompatibilities or open issues on GitHub. I have not tried this with co-op yet. I also take suggestions, either just for this mod or synergies with other mods! The GitHub repo is here: [url=https://github.com/drea-k-j/antisocial]drea-k-j/antisocial: A Stardew Mod where interacting with people takes energy[/url]
